$comment: Development dependencies whose own code the bundler injects into dist/ (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
§16, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). licence-gate checks them and third-party-notices lists them
alongside the production dependencies. Only the named package is included, not its
dependencies. Checked against a Vite 8.3.1 production build.
'licenceTextUntil' (optional) ends the notices copy of a licence file at that exact line.

packages.name: vite
packages.reason: Vite injects its module-preload polyfill and dynamic-import preload helper into the entry chunk.

packages.name: rolldown
packages.reason: Rolldown, Vite 8's bundler, injects its runtime helpers (for example CommonJS interop) into output chunks.
